content.short: Solnames is a Solana domain marketplace for exploring, registering, and buying domains.
content.description: Solnames is a Solana domain aggregator that consolidates domain listings from Bonfida, Sniper, Tensor and MagicEden. Explore available names across these marketplaces, instantly search thousands of domain names, and buy them directly through the app. In addition to listings, Solnames offers powerful tools to help guide your decision-making, enabling you to assess options, understand availability, and approach domain purchases with clearer, more informed judgment.
